method: Opened the final locally rendered catalog PNGs with the image viewer.

previews.visualReview: Vertical orange safety post with a yellow reflective sleeve, capped top, bolted steel base and visible faceting; reads clearly as a station bollard.
Open rectangular basin with backsplash, drain/spout details, separate dispensers and two steel legs; the steel and light polymer zones separate in the preview.
Wide duty console with a distinct dark angled screen, blue powder-coated housing, metal controls and yellow status buttons.

variant.visualReview: The same console shows a red powder-coated finish with dark screen, stainless detail and yellow controls; the label is fully visible.
